contributions: A checkable criterion and auditor for oracle reachability under declared information rights; independently reproduces 10/35 and 5/15 findings.
Measured unreachability in a synthetic benchmark: 12 drift families, 310 pair items, 260 reachable, 50 unreachable (16.1%); argument_merge 0/30, tool_replacement 15/35 retained, argument_split 40/40.
Synthetic drift generation introduces unreachable oracles that real API evolution does not in the measured control: 0/20 unreachable across 20 hand-verified real MCP/API version pairs.

Repairing an unreachable oracle can shrink a benchmark below its own statistical power: MDE 0.2975 at argument_split n=40, 0.4348 at tool_replacement n=15, and 0.2503 pooled, all above the pre-registered 0.20 effect.
mandatory_disclosures: Gate 08 pre-registered NEGATIVE result under DEC-0023.
RISK-0023 design-time exposure of three graded cases.
RISK-0020 narrow-claim boundary: Wilson upper bound 0.9333 against a 0.90 bar.
Small sample sizes and uncertainty intervals.
Single-system scope and tier-(b) case-study status.
Self-authored nature of the synthetic sandbox.
Gate 19 Path A was not audit-compatible; Path B found 0/20 unreachable and is a negative control, not external prevalence validation.
RISK-0022 raw-artifact contradiction: 0/85 literal :: constructions and 0 first-attempt successes in the five affected cases.
Gate 20 was cancelled by DEC-0047 after the pre-registered power analysis.
